name: turn_page
text: A standing person holds an open book in the left hand at chest height, looking down at the pages. The right hand reaches to the right edge of the book, lifts one page and sweeps it across from right to left, then rests again near the lower edge. The left hand stays steady supporting the book. One clear page-turning motion.

review.notes_zh: 左手稳定托书，右手抬起后从书的右缘横扫至左侧，再回到持书位；以看书姿态和明确手部路径重新生成。右手越过左手时高出约8至10厘米；只交翻页的手臂动作，不含纸页动画或捏页手指。
